Aura for Enterprise

Sovereign security.
Infinite scale.

Aura Enterprise (Tier 2) is designed for regulated industries (Banking, Healthcare, Defense) that require the acceleration of autonomous agents without the massive compliance and security risks of cloud-based inference logging.

{/* Enterprise Features */}

The Enterprise Gatekeeper

{/* Feature 1 */}

Sovereign Vault

Zero-Trust Local Vectorization

Competitors require enterprises to upload their raw, unredacted, proprietary chat transcripts to centralized SaaS servers to generate vector embeddings. Aura uses Shannon Entropy mathematics to scrub high-entropy secrets (API keys, PII) locally. The 768-dimensional neural vectors are generated, but the resulting RAG database is stored completely locally inside your `.git` folder.

{/* Feature 2 */}

Logic-Level RBAC

Compiler-Safe Virtual Workspaces

When enterprises hire external contractors, they want to provide a compiling codebase without leaking proprietary algorithms. Aura allows for Surgical Access Control. Using aura generate-stubs, you can physically remove proprietary logic from a contractor's machine, replacing it with compiler-safe "Logic Stubs" synthesized by local LLMs.

{/* Feature 3 */}

Cross-Repo Tracing

Monorepo & Microservice Scale

Standard blast radius detection works within a single repository. Aura Enterprise connects the Merkle-Graphs of all your organizational repositories. If an AI agent refactors a shared library in Repo A, Aura instantly projects the cascading failure into the microservices living in Repos B, C, and D before the PR is merged.

{/* Feature 4 */}

Git Notes Synchronization

Zero "Ref Explosions"

Instead of generating thousands of hidden branches to store metadata (which breaks enterprise CI/CD), Aura stores its semantic checkpoints directly into standard Git Notes. This allows for invisible, conflict-free synchronization across massive enterprise teams with zero disruption to your existing GitHub/GitLab infrastructure.

Upgrade to Aura Enterprise
